diagnostic.interpretation: A linear frozen-kernel approximation diagnostic; not task-weighted information loss or a causal AP estimate. SCDown contains SiLU and retraining changes the representation.
diagnostic.comparison_to_bsconv_paper: BSConv section 3.1 reports approximately 50 percent mean variance explained by centered PCA as motivation for compression. This report uses uncentered SVD squared-Frobenius energy; the quantities differ and neither establishes causal detection-information loss.

proposed_structure.branch: PW Cin->r / BN / SiLU / DW 3x3 stride2 padding1 / BN / linear PW r->Cout; scalar residual coefficient per site
limitations: Not implemented or trained; these are analytical resource estimates.
Low-rank factorization and residual branching have prior art; novelty is not established.
Additional operators can increase latency despite small MAC overhead.
proposed_structure.withdrawal_reason: User rejected compensation. Existing SCDown maintains or slightly improves baseline AP; frozen dense-kernel SVD energy is not evidence of a task-relevant defect requiring a residual branch.

current_research_focus: Compare BSConv-U and BSConv-S with SCDown: activation/BN placement, pointwise subspace factorization, orthonormal regularization, scope and experimental controls. No implementation or training requested.
